T4.reason: The fields are uniform, so no seam shows where they repeat, and a repeat test would pass trivially. But a featureless field is not a tiling texture of anything the brief names, so it scores 1 rather than 2.

T5.reason: Measured detail is 0 for every texture, against Half-Life's own median of 30.1 (inter-quartile 19.7 to 45). Seen flat, they have no grain, wear, edges or lettering, so they are far from as sharp or believable as Valve's textures.
